Composition rights
The original composition is in the public domain in the United States. Inferred, not documented

First publication 1906; the maximum historical U.S. term has expired. This does not clear an unidentified modern edition or assert worldwide status.

Commons identifies the performance as a U.S. Marine Corps government work, public domain in the United States. Documented

This is a U.S.-jurisdiction statement, not a claim of worldwide public-domain status. The composition and performance have separate rights grounds.
